title: Nested Data Structures
description: Work with lists of dictionaries representing complex nested data.

story.setup: MENTOR-9: "Real-world data is nested—lists of dictionaries, dictionaries of lists. Like JSON API responses or database query results. Let's build and query a list of system status dictionaries."
story.context: Nested structures combine lists and dicts for complex data. Each ship system is a dictionary, all systems in a list.
story.success: MENTOR-9: "Excellent! You created a list of system dictionaries, iterated through them, and extracted specific values. This is how real API testing works."

- Create dict 2: &{pwr} =    Create Dictionary    name=Power    status=Online    power=90
- Create dict 3: &{eng} =    Create Dictionary    name=Engines    status=Offline    power=0
hints: List of dictionaries: each list item is a dictionary

*** Settings ***
Library    Collections

*** Test Cases ***
Ship Systems Inventory
    @{systems}=    Create List
    &{nav}=    Create Dictionary    name=Navigation    status=Online    power=75
    &{pwr}=    Create Dictionary    name=Power    status=Online    power=90
    &{eng}=    Create Dictionary    name=Engines    status=Offline    power=0
    Append To List    ${systems}    ${nav}    ${pwr}    ${eng}
    Log    Systems: ${systems}
    ${count}=    Get Length    ${systems}
    Should Be Equal As Integers    ${count}    3
    FOR    ${system}    IN    @{systems}
        ${name}=    Get From Dictionary    ${system}    name
        ${status}=    Get From Dictionary    ${system}    status
        Log    ${name}: ${status}
    END
    ${first_system}=    Get From List    ${systems}    0
    ${first_name}=    Get From Dictionary    ${first_system}    name
    Should Be Equal    ${first_name}    Navigation

theory.title: Exercise 4.1.5: Nested Data Structures
theory.content:
MENTOR-9: "API responses, database records, configuration files—they're all nested structures. A user object has addresses (list), each address has properties (dict). You need to navigate multiple levels of nesting."

Lists of Dictionaries

Combine lists and dictionaries for complex data:

@{users}=    Create List
&{user1}=    Create Dictionary    name=Alice    role=Admin
&{user2}=    Create Dictionary    name=Bob    role=User
Append To List    ${users}    ${user1}    ${user2}

FOR    ${user}    IN    @{users}
    ${name}=    Get From Dictionary    ${user}    name
    Log    User: ${name}
END

Access Patterns:

  • Get list item: ${users}[0] → first dict
  • Get dict value: Get From Dictionary ${users}[0] name
  • Iterate list: FOR loop, each item is dict
  • Query values: Get From Dictionary inside loop

Example: API Response Processing

*** Settings ***
Library    Collections

*** Test Cases ***
Process API Response
    @{products}=    Create List
    &{p1}=    Create Dictionary    id=101    price=29.99    stock=50
    &{p2}=    Create Dictionary    id=102    price=49.99    stock=0
    Append To List    ${products}    ${p1}    ${p2}
    
    FOR    ${product}    IN    @{products}
        ${stock}=    Get From Dictionary    ${product}    stock
        IF    ${stock} == 0
            ${id}=    Get From Dictionary    ${product}    id
            Log    Product ${id} out of stock!
        END
    END

⚠️ Nested Structure Tips

  • Common pattern: list of dicts (records/rows)
  • Also: dict of lists (categories with items)
  • Use FOR loops to iterate outer structure
  • Use Get From Dictionary/List for inner access
  • Real-world: JSON API responses, database results
  • Can nest 3+ levels deep (list of dicts of lists...)
